payload.title: hybrid-search max_distance is a no-op in hybrid mode (RRF fused-rank score reported under distance key)
payload.context: Surfaced by qa during RAG-FTS verify (NOT a regression — git show 619eea227 confirms 0 lines changed in search()/hybrid_search()). With default max_distance=0.8: hybrid=true returns results while hybrid=false returns 0 for the identical query; hybrid distance values cluster suspiciously tight (0.0216-0.0242), consistent with an RRF fused-rank score being reported under the distance key -> max_distance effectively a no-op in hybrid mode.
payload.disposition: PRE-EXISTING, non-blocking. Backlog note for PO to prioritize with dev-rag-service (semantics: should hybrid max_distance filter on the vector leg distance, or is RRF-score-under-distance-key intended?).
